text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Osaka Hai, and Gold City appears unable to put her mind to the race. She's unsure whether she should run in her feckless state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's running without a goal, but she won't allow this to make her look like a loser. Despite her lack of enthusiasm, she heads off to start the race.
